name: @failproofai/jev-policies
description: The FailproofAI policy pack: a regex floor plus the 16 semantic (Jev) checks, shipped as a pack instead of compiled into the CLI.
//: The peer range keeps the -beta.0 suffix on purpose: a plain >=1.0.7 would EXCLUDE 1.0.7-beta.0, the build the semantic tier actually ships in, because npm semver admits a prerelease only when a comparator names that same x.y.z tuple. Verified under semver 6.3.1 and 7.8.5 — it admits 1.0.7-beta.0, 1.0.7 and every later stable, and refuses 1.0.7-alpha.0. Caveat: a later prerelease on a DIFFERENT tuple (1.0.8-beta.0, 1.1.0-beta.0) is not admitted, so widen this when the next beta line opens.
